description: dataflow-captive-lifecycle differential chain over EPLDataflowAPIStartCaptive as the captive start/submit/signal/cancel lifecycle of one dataflow instance plus the instantiate-only doc sample (the whole class is ONE execution, the 'direct' variant): captive-emitter (ordinal 0) replays the run() body in source order in two flows. Flow A deploys the byte-exact one-line graph '@name('flow') create dataflow MyDataFlow Emitter -> outstream<MyOAEventType> {name:'src1'}DefaultSupportCaptureOp(outstream) {}' under the pinned deployment id 'flow' (no space between {name:'src1'} and DefaultSupportCaptureOp), instantiates with a fresh unlatched DefaultSupportCaptureOp supplied through DefaultSupportGraphOpProvider, and drives the instance through startCaptive(): after start it records the count record flow runnables=0 (the captive handle holds zero GraphSourceRunnables), the count record flow emitters=1 (exactly one emitter, keyed internally by the Emitter NAME parameter 'src1' and asserted non-null, the count is the emitter-map size), and the state record flow instance.state=RUNNING; the submissions of {'E1',10} then {'E2',20} accumulate in the capture current batch and are recorded as capture reads flow:DefaultSupportCaptureOp new=[{'p0':'E1','p1':10}] and new=[E1,E2]; the EPDataFlowSignalFinalMarker submission splits the batch — the current read is recorded explicitly empty with new=[] (the marker identity is not observable) and the received batch is recorded from getAndReset().get(0) as new=[E1,E2] (reset semantics); the post-signal {'E3',30} starts a fresh current batch recorded as new=[{'p0':'E3','p1':30}]; the instance stays RUNNING after the final-marker signal (no transition to complete, asserted explicitly at suite line 62 and recorded again as state RUNNING) and instance.cancel() moves the state to CANCELLED, recorded as the tenth record. Captured rows are the raw Object[] underlyings serialized positionally as p0/p1 (no envelope, no coercion). Flow B then undeploys and deploys the byte-exact multi-line doc sample graph '@name('flow') create dataflow HelloWorldDataFlow / create schema SampleSchema(text string),\t// sample type\t\t / \t / Emitter -> helloworld.stream<SampleSchema> { name: 'myemitter' } / LogSink(helloworld.stream) {}' with the tabs and trailing whitespace exactly as the Java source concatenates them, instantiates with NO options — never started, never cancelled, so LogSink never runs — and records the eleventh state record flow instance.state=INSTANTIATED before the final undeployAll. Session configuration mirrors TestSuiteEPLDataflow.configure restricted to this execution: the MyOAEventType object-array event type with String p0 / int p1 ('MyOAEventType', 'p0,p1'.split(','), {String.class, int.class}) and the com.espertech.esper.common.internal.epl.dataflow.util.* import that resolves DefaultSupportCaptureOp in EPL text, while Emitter and LogSink resolve through the built-in ConfigurationCommon.DATAFLOWOPERATOR_IMPORT; internal timer off, epoch initialization 0, one fresh runtime destroyed in finally. Record protocol: every capture read is one record {case, operation:'capture', statement:'flow:DefaultSupportCaptureOp', sequence, time, new:[rows]} with rows shaped {'kind':'row','fields':{'p0':...,'p1':...}} and empty reads recorded explicitly with new:[]; state observables are {case, operation:'state', statement:'flow', sequence, time, name:'instance.state', value:'INSTANTIATED'|'RUNNING'|'CANCELLED'} records and size observables are {case, operation:'count', statement:'flow', sequence, time, name, count} records, both carrying the create-start-stop-destroy statement label 'flow'. The suite's assertEquals calls (runnables size, emitters size, the 'src1' emitter key, every state read and every row projection) are replayed as in-process asserts feeding the records. Sequence is case-local restarting at 1, the time is the fixed epoch 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, and the 11 records (10 flow-A + 1 flow-B) carry the captive-lifecycle differential chain.
